payload.title: Offline-queue blob/media uploads in FrickSwift (FrickClient.uploadBlobContent)
payload.description: FrickSyncSocket already queues object writes + stream appends while offline and replays on reconnect, but FrickClient.uploadBlobContent (blob PUT) throws when offline rather than queuing. Field apps capturing photos offline (Aquarius AQ-85) can durably queue the Media OBJECT write but not the blob bytes — the photo upload surfaces an error until reconnect. Add offline queuing/replay for blob content uploads (local blob staging → flush on reconnect) so media capture is fully offline-first. Surfaced by Aquarius AQ-85.
